review_scope: Read-only exact-source phase, success predicates and failure-path interpretation. No private console read, no candidate edit, no native or model execution.
pre_mark_done_requires: The selected outbound payload has a first-attempt mode-0600 receipt with schema 1, requested type m.room.message, the exact post-send/pre-mark ack-disposition, and its expected plaintext-body SHA256.
The receipt transaction and event identifiers parse; the human timeline event is the first Synapse event identifier from that receipt.
The corresponding durable outbox record reaches Sent with exactly two attempts; its payload equals the selected body and its sent event identifier equals the receipt event identifier.
The three named transient hook files are absent, and the sampled pending inbox, dispatch and outbox queues are empty.
The downstream capture has no parser errors and exactly two requests matching that transaction, both PUT and byte-equal to the expected complete encrypted-send URI.
After another human sync, the selected decrypted body occurs once in the accumulated seen list and model A has exactly two requests.
pre_mark_limits: The wire helper compares method and complete URI; it does not compare two HTTP request-body byte strings. Do not call it an independent equality proof for the encrypted request bodies.

The predicate is scoped to this selected message and the observed prefix. Later stable-count freeze, all-message encryption, shutdown, network recovery, sidecar recovery, generation rollover and final isolation predicates have not thereby passed.
This completed A phase does not establish B health or B post-cancel reconciliation.
authority_cancelled_requires: A real B pending approval was observed with an active turn and exactly one approval; Cancel was an allowed decision.
After the authority-looking Matrix message and original 750ms wait, active thread, active turn, approval list and fence still equal the pre-message values, and model B still has one request.
An owner-local fenced ResolveApproval(Cancel) request was accepted; the pending approval thread equals the original active thread.
The control snapshot becomes idle with no pending approvals, and the exact old thread/turn inbox dispatch record reaches Completed before the cancelled stage marker.
resume_and_queue_start_done_requires: The generation-bound Agentd client returns the expected App Server socket; the owner-local remote client resumes the exact original thread.
Across the paginated queue listing, exactly one submission matches client_user_message_id derived from B and the actual authority Matrix event room/event identifiers.
A typed ThreadQueueStart response for that exact queued submission is received and the remote client shutdown call succeeds.
resume_limits: The returned ThreadQueueStartResponse is returned without an additional assertion of new Matrix dispatch persistence or output delivery.
No completed-stage marker proves the subsequent model request, Matrix reconciliation, encrypted send, decryption or reply delivery.

next_failure_boundary.wait_behavior: Runs human sync_once(1000ms) until a newly returned decrypted text message matches both sender and body. It does not search old seen records as the success test.
next_failure_boundary.inner_error_behavior: SDK sync, timeline deserialization and undecrypted-event errors propagate as the inner Result; the outer timeout context is applied only to the timeout error.
next_failure_boundary.on_error: Exactly one failure-path Supervisor tick plus bounded snapshots/events/retained child logs via authority_probe_wait_for_body, then return the original error.
next_failure_boundary.diagnostic_limit: The post-failure sample is not a continuous health history. This review does not parse or re-export its raw contents.

not_reached_if_that_await_returns_error: The assertion that authority text appeared as ordinary user model input and authority_probe:done.
A proxy reconnect, A process/fence recovery checks, stale-fence rejection and peer-unchanged check.
A offline-message reply, post-recovery durable drain, model-A count 3 and network_disconnect_recovery:done.
Subsequent sidecar restart, generation rollover, final stable-count/isolation/shutdown and whole qualification PASS.
smallest_next_evidence_and_fix_scope: The ARM owner should bind the reported StoreOperation and its Unavailable conversion to the actual product input source and retain the first fixed underlying diagnostic if already available.
Distinguish the completed old canceled dispatch from the newly resumed queued turn: a successful queue/start response does not prove the Matrix durable reconciliation write succeeded.

An exact underlying store/reconciliation cause can justify a narrow change in that call chain. The present phase evidence alone does not justify authentication changes, retries, larger deadlines, weaker queue/assertion gates or changes to the not-yet-reached A reconnect.

If the original Unavailable mapping discarded the lower cause, retain that observation gap explicitly; do not infer SQLite busy, corruption, locking or a common authentication cause from the display string.
